summary: First full-pass testing of Sócio Digital MVP. Backend: 24/25 pytest passed, 1 skipped (non-issue). Frontend: all 13 requested feature flows verified end-to-end via Playwright: login/register/onboarding, dashboard KPIs+charts, Financeiro list+filters+search, Radar alerts+resolve+recompute, Clientes, Estoque upload/empty-state, Configurações team add/remove, theme toggle light↔dark, mobile sidebar (Sheet) hamburger, chat streaming (Claude Sonnet 5 with tool-calling returns grounded pt-BR answer), logout, JWT protected routes.

issues: Radix DialogContent console warning: requires a DialogTitle for screen readers. Wrap current header content with DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden) to fix accessibility warning. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional a11y polish: add <DialogTitle> (VisuallyHidden if not visible) to Sheet/Dialog components used in MobileNav and Team Add dialog to remove Radix accessibility console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: dashboard_routes.py line 21 uses a hacky `__import__('datetime').timedelta`; the module is already imported at the top — refactor to use imported `timedelta` directly for readability.

server.py has `allow_credentials=True` combined with `allow_origins=['*']` — browsers reject credentialed requests with wildcard origin. Since auth here uses Bearer tokens (not cookies), it works, but CORS config is technically invalid; either drop allow_credentials or set specific origins.
chat_routes.py: EMERGENT_LLM_KEY read via os.environ[...] at import time will crash the whole app if the env var is missing; consider os.environ.get with a friendly error at first request.
upload_routes.py `parse_transactions_csv` broad `except Exception` may leak internal parser errors in the 400 message; consider catching specific parse errors and logging the traceback separately.
No idempotency / de-duplication on transactions CSV upload — re-uploading the same CSV inserts duplicates. Consider hashing (date+description+amount) to warn/skip duplicates.
No RBAC on transactions delete / dashboard endpoints — any authenticated user (including 'member') can delete transactions. Consider requiring owner/manager for destructive ops.
test_credentials: ana.souza@teste.com / senha123 (existing owner); new test users are auto-created per pytest session
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create ephemeral TEST_ users with random emails via /api/auth/register; they upload sample tx and inventory CSVs. Not cleaned up (Mongo grows monotonically over test runs).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_socio_digital.py exercises auth, uploads (tx & inventory), dashboard summary/cashflow/categories, transactions list+filter+delete, radar list/recompute/resolve, customers, inventory (with risk classification), team add/remove, chat history+stream. If retesting: fixtures generate a fresh user each session so tests are self-contained. Ana's data (dated Dec/2025-Jan/2026) will read as 'receita do mês=0' when server clock is in a later month — this is correct behavior, not a bug (observed 2026-08 during this run).
rca of the issue: N/A - no blocking issues found. Only a Radix a11y console warning about missing DialogTitle in Sheet/Dialog components; the app is fully functional.
